summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced Opportunity Pricing Engine with new features. Backend APIs are 100% functional including HR Config, quick create endpoints, and calculation engines. Frontend shows all required features but has calculation display issues and minor UI interaction problems.

calculation_issues.issue: Utilization mode and Seconded employee calculations returning 0.00 SAR
calculation_issues.impact: Users see incorrect pricing for utilization-based and seconded employee calculations

ui_bugs.issue: DOM element detachment during dropdown interactions causing 'Element is not attached to the DOM' errors
ui_bugs.impact: Intermittent failures when selecting roles or employee types

ui_bugs.issue: Roles table shows headers but no data rows despite API returning data
ui_bugs.impact: Admin cannot see role data in the table view

integration_issues.issue: Calculation results showing 0.00 SAR for utilization-based team members
Calculation results showing 0.00 SAR for seconded employees with custom salary/allowance

design_issues.issue: Google Sheets URL input and import button not appearing when toggle is enabled

passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/roles returns calculated benefits (Social Insurance, Medical, End of Service, Total Monthly Cost)
✅ POST /api/roles/quick creates role without admin auth
✅ POST /api/vendor-services/quick creates vendor without admin auth
✅ PUT /api/hr-config updates HR configuration with admin auth
✅ Simple Calculator - Hours mode calculation working
✅ Team member row with Hours/Utilization toggle
✅ Team member dropdown has 'Add new role...' option
✅ Vendor dropdown has 'Add new vendor service...' option
✅ Admin HR Config page - Benefits percentage inputs found
✅ Admin HR Config page - Example calculation preview working
✅ Admin HR Config page - Google Sheets toggle present
✅ Admin Roles page - Shows all benefit columns (Social Insurance, Medical Ins., End of Service, Total Monthly)
✅ Admin panel navigation and all sections accessible
✅ Mode switching between Simple and Structured calculators
action_item_for_main_agent: 1) Fix calculation logic for utilization mode and seconded employees - currently returning 0.00 SAR. 2) Fix roles table data display in admin panel. 3) Resolve DOM element detachment issues in dropdown components. 4) Fix Google Sheets integration UI elements not appearing when toggle is enabled.
